theorems.name: Submission.dgoj_graph_fderiv_left_inverse
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → (∀ (v : Euclid n) (w : Euclid k), ι.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (ι v + ι' w) = v) ∧ ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v))) (ball (0 : Euclid n) s) ∧ ∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∀ w : Euclid n, ι.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v w) = w
